offering_description.value: Develops and markets ready-to-drink protein shakes, powders and other convenient nutrition products under consumer brands. Sells to consumers through retailers and online. Products are made by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: ready-to-drink protein shakes; protein powders; nutrition bars; high-protein snacks

customer_segment.value: B2C: health-conscious consumers, fitness and active lifestyle buyers; B2B: club, mass, grocery, e-commerce and specialty retailers, and distributors

end_markets.value: convenient nutrition; sports nutrition; weight management; packaged food and beverage

revenue_model.value: product sales: protein shakes and powders sold to retailers, distributors and online

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets nutrition products made by contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with sales in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: ready-to-drink shakes, powders, and bars and snacks under consumer nutrition brands

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: club stores, mass merchants, grocery and drug stores; online: e-commerce retailers and brand direct websites; distributors / dealers: specialty and international distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food and dietary supplement labeling and safety rules from FDA and FTC
